The main takeaway from our work is that

the translabyrinthine route of surgery for vestibular Schwannoma (VS) is associated with significant improvement in patient-reported outcomes, with 24% reporting an improved quality of life and 35% reporting vivid dreams.
patients undergoing surgery for VS via the translabyrinthines approach are not only satisfied with the surgical results but also have improved QOL scores.
the SF-36 questionnaire is a useful and reliable tool for assessing the QOL of patients following vestibular schwannomas surgery.
